root_cause.symptom: apply wrote managed skills to skills/<skill>/<suffix2>/<rest> (on/rs/nt/ts = last 2 chars of skill name); rollback emitted ROLLBACK_REQUIRED; second install showed [UPDATE] for all skills instead of [SKIP]
root_cause.mechanism: install.ps1 computed relative paths as $sf.FullName.Substring($srcDir.Length + 1) over files ENUMERATED from the stage dir under $env:TEMP. On GitHub runners TEMP uses the 8.3 short form (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...); Get-ChildItem returns FullName canonicalized to the long form (runneradmin, +3 chars) while $srcDir keeps the short form, so Substring cut 2 chars into the skill directory name. Reproduced the canonicalization behavior locally (Get-ChildItem C:\PROGRA~1 returns C:\Program Files\... while [IO.Directory] keeps the short form).
root_cause.fix: single ManagedOperation collection; RelativePath computed ONCE from canonical source enumeration composed only from child Name values (prefix-agnostic), carried as immutable data through plan/expected-hashes/backup/stage/CAS/apply/manifest/rollback; no Substring on enumerated FullName anywhere in install.ps1
